run_preprocess_binarize: run the fairseq preprocess CLI to build vocabularies and binarize training data for machine translation
build_dictionary: build a source or target language dictionary from training text files with frequency thresholding
make_binary_dataset: create a binarized dataset from text input files using a vocabulary and multiprocess workers
align_files: generate an alignment dictionary mapping source tokens to target tokens from an alignment file
make_binary_alignment_dataset: binarize alignment data files into a multiprocessed dataset using the alignment binarizer
